messages:
jules: Heads-up, totally non-serious poll — if our models had outfits for a company runway, what would they wear? I'll go first. Redwood-Base: comfy hoodie + noise-canceling headphones, always ready for late-night evals. :headphones:

sam: Redwood-Lite = windbreaker and sneakers. Always on the move, 60ms latency per step. :running:

anya: Redwood-Resilient would rock a utility vest with too many pockets (for caches & keys). Also elbow patches. :thumbsup:

devin: Redwood-Optimizer wears a lab coat with pocket calculators and a vintage profiler pinned to it. :nerd_face:

marco: Redwood-Chatty shows up in a blazer with a million buttons (for different system prompts). Slightly dramatic. :tophat: (reacted with :laughing:)

ops-bot: deploy-bot: FYI — runway CSS pushed to staging. No rollback detected. :shipit:

anya: Also imagine a tiny scarf for the KV cache. Very chic. :scarf:

sam: can someone make a sprite sheet? maybe 'model-catwalk.png' I volunteer to make the first sketch tomorrow.

jules: love it. bonus points if the outfit includes a hidden quantization pocket. :money_with_wings:

devin: Official vote: which is the mascot outfit? Reply with the name. I'll tally.

marco: voting for Redwood-Chatty (blazer w/buttons) — it's chaotic but lovable.

anya: voting Redwood-Resilient — pockets for days.

sam: voting Redwood-Base (hoodie life).

jules: voting Redwood-Optimizer. nerd coat forever.

ops-bot: poll result (manual): Redwood-Chatty 1, Redwood-Resilient 1, Redwood-Base 1, Redwood-Optimizer 1 — it's a four-way tie. :bar_chart:

jules: tie-breaker: make a tiny pixel runway for the office screensaver? who wants to help animate? :pixels:

sam: me! i'll bring coffee and sprites.

anya: i'll handle sound effects (tiny token chime).

devin: i'll wire in a "slow-mo quantize" easter egg.

jules: amazing — putting you all in a tiny doc. thanks team :heart:
